# Program-status recordings

Recorded terminal output (`*.bin`) and the byte count of each read at recording
time (`*.reads`, whitespace-separated decimals), copied from gascity
`internal/runtime/programstatus/testdata/`, commit
`0997336456fe67f0315d9e41dabc7167e74c2fa9`.
